The '''''Windsinger''''' was one of the most famous [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class light cruisers]] that operated during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The ''Windsinger'' had a high-calibre crew and under their control, the [[Light cruiser/Legends|light cruiser]] had a long, respectable career, performing missions such as combating [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] rebellions, [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]] and rogue military [[Officer/Legends|officers]]. The ''Windsinger'' disappeared shortly before the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and according to a number of rumors, the ship continued to reappear from time to time over several decades, to rescue passengers from starships wrecks and to attack pirates and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] starships without warning. However, the rumors were never confirmed.
